question_text: The fluoride concentration of lakes in a particular region was found to be $3 \times 10^{-4}\text{ g per litre}$.

subparts.stem: One lake has $5.6 \times 10^8\text{ litres}$ of water. Find the amount of fluoride in the lake, giving your answer in scientific notation.

ai_explanation.concept_rule: Total mass equals concentration multiplied by volume.
step_by_step: Convert to standard scientific notation: $16.8 \times 10^4 = 1.68 \times 10^5\text{ g}$.
ai_explanation.common_pitfalls: Leaving the final coefficient greater than 10.

subparts.stem: Another lake contains $4.13 \times 10^7\text{ g}$ of fluoride. Find the volume of the lake.

mark_breakdown.desc: Correct answer rounded to 3 significant figures

ai_explanation.concept_rule: Volume is found by dividing total amount by concentration.
